{{Quote|Surgical Pathologist - Level 2, Research Laboratory|Command console readout|<ref name="SWG:RFL1" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Tare Sal''' was a surgical pathologist who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Sal conducted operations as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Scientist/Legends|science]] staff in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, scientists were secretly conducting dangerous scientific research for the Empire, intending to re-engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. Dr. Sal operated on level 2 of the research laboratory.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tare Sal was present when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment. The virus killed most of the people ins the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|area]], turning them into [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tare Sal was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Mention of Tare Sal was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
